title: Hedge Fund Valuation - Retailization, Regulation and Investor Suitability
abstract: I. Introduction Valuation issues could become the next "black eye" for the hedge fund industry.2 The credit crunch and the global financial crisis have underscored that the valuation of complex financial products and hard-to-value assets is one of the most pressing issues affecting confidence in the financial industry today.3 Pricing and valuation errors do happen despite efforts to ensure fair pricing at all times.4 As discussed below, hedge funds cannot always ensure accurate valuation.5 This

Perhaps these requirements for investor suitability could provide a general framework for buyers and sellers in the market for certain complex and hard-to-value financial products.
